sentence: She has been working all day. She must to be tired.
ruleVi: Must + động từ nguyên mẫu không to để suy đoán chắc chắn.

sentence: He is driving a brand-new Ferrari, so he mustn't be poor.
ruleVi: Suy đoán chắc chắn là không thể: dùng can't, không dùng mustn't (mustn't là cấm).

sentence: Lan isn't answering. She might sleeping.
ruleVi: Đoán việc đang diễn ra: might be + V-ing.

sentence: Take an umbrella. It may rains later.
ruleVi: Sau may/might/could là động từ nguyên mẫu.

sentence: That can't is Minh, because he lives in Japan.
ruleVi: Can't + be nguyên mẫu: That can't be Minh.

sentence: Don't touch the soup; it could being very hot.
ruleVi: Could + động từ nguyên mẫu: could be.

sentence: Someone is at the door. It might is the postman.
ruleVi: Might + be nguyên mẫu để nói điều có thể đúng.

sentence: I'm not sure, but Hoa could comes tomorrow.
ruleVi: Sau could không thêm -s: could come.

sentence: His car is outside, so he can't be at home.
ruleVi: Có bằng chứng (xe ở nhà) thì suy đoán chắc chắn đúng dùng must be.

sentence: We may not to finish on time.
ruleVi: May not + động từ nguyên mẫu không to.
